title: The Message
summary: Sarah meets Michael after receiving an anonymous message. Michael denies sending it.

title: The Building

clues: Michael knows more than he admits
questionsRaised: Why did Michael lie about the building?

clues: Key was taken by someone who knew about it

title: Descent
summary: Michael decides to go to the basement. Sarah insists on following him.

title: The Basement

title: The Cabinet

clues: Something is hidden behind the cabinet
questionsRaised: What is hidden behind the cabinet?

title: The Photograph
